name: Rabbi Dr. Tirzah Firestone
reason: Too thin under the rules as they stand today: much of her current work (tirzahfirestone.com) is intergenerational trauma healing, so the Wounds into Wisdom book, ancestral-healing courses and practitioner circle fail the health rule; what is left is one current course (The Alchemy of Heartbreak, from 11 Nov 2026, $360, borderline because it is framed around grief) and her Shift on-demand courses (linked from her ancestral-healing page, counting once). Her clean books (The Receiving, With Roots in Heaven, The Woman's Kabbalah) could not be confirmed because Open Library refused our connections during this run, and she has no YouTube channel. Worth a re-run when Open Library answers: she has a published email (info@tirzahfirestone.com), one usable photo, and her site names Shift courses.
